name: Enerpac Tool Group Corp.
summary: Enerpac Tool Group Corp. manufactures and sells a range of industrial products and solutions in the United States, Germany, Australia, Canada, China, Saudi Arabia, Brazil, France, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company designs, manufactures, and distributes branded hydraulic and mechanical tools; and provides services and tool rentals to the general industrial, refining and petrochemical, industrial maintenance, repair and operations, machining and manufacturing, power generation, infrastructure, mining and other markets.
